name: Simulcast (Monster)
body:
The monster can cast a spell while taking other actions.

Prerequisite: 6 or more limbs (tentacles and wings count), or 2 or more heads (medusa snakes count), or 4 or more eyestalks, ability to cast 1st level spells.

Benefit: A limited number of times per day, the monster can use its extra appendages to cast a spell as a free action (while still taking a full round of other actions). It cannot do this on a round it casts another spell or uses a spell-like ability. It may do this once per day, plus once for every 5 HD it possesses.
